description_expanded: ABOUT THE POOL HOUSE: Located in Seacrest Beach, The Pool House sits right in front of a 12,000 sq foot lagoon style pool perfect for those wanting a prime location. This home features 5 bed, 3.5 bath, a 2 car garage, and 4 complimentary bikes, accommodating a total of 14 guests. This home has more than enough room for entertaining, taking relaxing naps, and watching movies after a long day at the beach. If you're looking for the perfect vacation home, THIS is it! Walking into the first floor you'll find the queen bedroom and twin bunk room with a shared jack and jill bathroom. Traveling up to the second floor is where the recently updated kitchen is, with ample space and an island for serving, making for a fun evening of cooking, visiting, and entertaining. Just off the kitchen is the second floor master bedroom with King sized bed with a private balcony access and master bathroom. The third floor is a hidden gem. A second king master bedroom with a daybed and with connecting bunk room and bathroom giving plenty of space for friends and family to sleep. The master bathroom has a double vanity, separate tub and shower, and a private 3rd floor balcony. Don't miss out and book The Pool House today! ABOUT THE AREA: Seacrest Beach, Florida, is a charming coastal community nestled along the renowned Emerald Coast. Situated between the iconic beach destinations of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach offers a tranquil escape with easy access to the area's vibrant attractions and natural splendor. Beyond its breathtaking beaches, Seacrest Beach boasts a laid-back atmosphere and a sense of community that is both welcoming and inclusive. Stroll along the cobblestone streets lined with quaint cottages and lush landscaping, and you ll discover a thriving village center brimming with boutiques, cafes, and restaurants. From eclectic eateries serving up fresh seafood to charming shops offering unique souvenirs and artisanal goods, there is something to delight every palate and preference. For those seeking outdoor recreation, Seacrest Beach offers a wealth of options to explore its natural beauty. Take a leisurely bike ride along scenic trails, meander through the unique shops and boutiques, or embark on a sunset hike to catch breathtaking views of the coastline. Nearby state parks and nature preserves provide opportunities for birdwatching, wildlife spotting, and immersive encounters with the area's diverse ecosystems. In addition to its natural attractions, Seacrest Beach hosts a variety of events and activities throughout the year, from live music performances and art festivals to farmers markets and community gatherings. Whether you re a year-round resident or a visitor seeking a memorable vacation, there's always something exciting happening in Seacrest Beach. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests.
